title: Body fluid diagnostics using activatable optical probes
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3906-3929
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01315H, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jie Zhan, Yanbin Cai, Penghui Cheng, Lei Zheng, Kanyi Pu
This review highlights recent advances in activatable optical probes for body fluid diagnostics, including their molecular design, applications in pre-clinical and clinical specimens, and the challenges and future prospects in precision medicine.
